ThingDef.label: Armiger life-support module
ThingDef.description: A sealed life-support module for the Armiger Knight, forged at the Mechanicum manufactorum. Fitted at the hangar (optional), it recycles air, fluids and neural coolant for the pilot and greatly slows neural strain, ageing and the shock of damage, so the Knight can fight for days.
